positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
Mobile technologies team:
- Owner of firm-wide document storage system that provides download, annotations, upload, tagging,
document creation, picture taking, and sharing of documents from a mobile device.  Using Java, MongoDB, proprietary configuration tools, and integration with Dropbox API to develop and maintain web application/service layer, as well as iOS native application written in Objective C.

- Worked with various teams in the firm to ensure compliance with all firm and regulatory requirements
for document storage.

- iOS developer (Objective C) as part of larger team who owns platform of enterprise mobile applications and proprietary secure framework.

Application development for Capital Markets deal execution, including book building, trade booking, reporting and analytics:
-Designed and developed native iOS application, using Objective C, to provide real time analytics and charts, with data encryption and offline data availability. Won Best Use of IT in Investment Banking in 2013.

-Web development for book building systems using Java, C#, javascript, etc.

Application development for Investment Banking:
-Ownership of common component API in C# for Investment Banking Technology for market data and other reference data. Later to include intuitive type-ahead search, used as the entry point for an in-house financial portal for Investment Bankers, requiring SQL tuning and optimizing stored procedures.
